 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Real Madrid are expected to finalise the signing of young prodigy JJ Gabriel (16) in the coming days, according to reports from RMC Sport .
 Regarded as one of the greatest talents to come out of Manchester United's academy, the attacking midfielder is set to sign a three-year contract with Los Merengues. Having joined Carrington at the age of 10, the London-born player posted a farewell video on social media reflecting on his six years with the Red Devils.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Although he was expected to sign his first professional contract with United, Gabriel decided to leave the club, largely due to what he felt was a lack of playing time during pre-season. His omission from the squad selected to face Sabah FC in the Champions League would also have been a source of disappointment.
 Also courted by FC Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich, the player – who usually plays on the wings or as an attacking midfielder – has finally chosen to join Real Madrid.
 GFFN | Léo Aschi
